title:
`.env.example` has been lying
to every new hire
since October 2020.
subtitle: It claims `DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/app`. In reality, the database is an Amazon DocumentDB replica wrapped in SSH tunnels requiring 4 client certificates and a VPN from 2016.
logs: > asking team channel: 'Hey, what are the actual env variables?'
> Senior Dev: 'Oh yeah, half of those are deprecated, DM me for the real ones'.
> Senior Dev sends secret string via unencrypted Slack DM.
> secret string has expired AWS credentials.
footnote: Error code: `DEPRECATED-CONFIG-404` · Lies told in README: 14 · Onboarding hours lost: 40
pathTemplate: Finding `{path}` requires credentials that were never documented in `.env.example`.
